{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the dtype of revenue
print("Revenue column dtype before conversion:", sales['revenue'].dtype)

# Convert revenue to float, coercing errors to NaN
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check the dtype after conversion
print("Revenue column dtype after conversion:", sales['revenue'].dtype)

# Now count zero-revenue orders
zero_revenue = sales[sales['revenue'] == 0].shape[0]
total_orders = sales.shape[0]
print(f"Number of orders with zero revenue: {zero_revenue} / {total_orders}")

# Check if these zero-revenue orders are 'completed'
zero_revenue_completed = sales[(sales['revenue'] == 0) & (sales['status'] == 'completed')].shape[0]
print(f"Number of zero-revenue orders that are completed: {zero_revenue_completed}")

# Check the converted status of zero-revenue orders
print("Converted status of zero-revenue orders:")
print(sales[sales['revenue'] == 0]['converted'].value_counts())"}
